name: Canvas XL
notes: Music Easel patch field with four independent random outputs. Select PATCH to connect any control source to an input. FX fires the pulser. The Arpeggiator has a rate input in Hz. Missing: external audio/preamp/envelope detector and linear decay. Pulse/wave rows use numbers; sine is extra. Plates, trims, program cards and local/remote switching need hardware or storage. Low range starts at 0.22 Hz, not 0.17. Output split remains unverified.
